definition: Lillian Lee is a computer scientist whose research involves natural language processing, sentiment analysis, and computational social science.
details: She is a professor of computer science and information science at Cornell University, and co-editor-in-chief of the journal Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Lillian Lee (computer scientist).
